text:
marie: Quick sync — deciding between per-tenant sidecar shims vs a centralized delegation service for API v2->v3 compatibility. Who wants to weigh tradeoffs?
cesar: Sidecars give isolation and locality but increase per-pod resource & egress complexity. Harder to roll out across 1000 tenants.
liam: Central delegator easier to instrument & deploy, but it's a single latency/throughput bottleneck. Needs autoscale and backpressure.
anya: Observability-wise sidecars win (per-tenant traces + local logs). But we can emit synthetic traces from central if we tag requests well.
sam: Ops POV: hybrid seems promising — router-level lightweight rewrites for payload shape changes, sidecars for streaming/KV-cache changes.
cesar: Router rewrites cover many transforms (headers/body) and are low-friction. For streaming protocol or signed payloads you need local handling.
marie: FYI perf proto: central delegator p95 increased ~40ms under 80% load. Sidecar adds ~12ms jitter but scales horizontally. I'll upload numbers.
deploy-bot: deploy started: canary-delegator -> prod-canary-3 (build 20260320.3)
liam: If we go hybrid we must split ownership: eng-runtime for router transforms; eng-platform for sidecar lifecycle + CI images. Agreement?
anya: That works. Also require a 'compat-mode' header and telemetry: compat.variant, shim.version, transform.type. Dashboards mandatory.
sam: Proposed rollout: enable router-rewrite opt-in for small cohort (5 tenants) -> monitor -> expand. Use sidecars for tenants that cannot use router rewrites.
cesar: Security note: requests with signed HMAC can't be rewritten by router (can't re-sign). Sidecar needs KMS access; security review required.
marie: Add security review and compliance check. Tentative timeline: 6w for router-rewrite rollout, 4w for sidecar backfill for special tenants.
liam: Quick example stub for router transform:
```
if headers['x-api-version']=='v2' and route.supports_v3:
    payload = translate_v2_to_v3(payload)
```
anya: I'll own telemetry dashboards + runbook. Canary alert thresholds: error rate >0.5% OR latency regress >15% => rollback.
marie: Great. I'll draft RFC follow-up with hybrid pattern, ownership matrix, timeline, and blockers (KMS + perf). Ping me if you want to be tagged as reviewer. :thumbsup:
